stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Immobilizer Kontrol Modülü (J362)
Kontrol edin:  Immobilizer Kontrol Modülü (J362) Coding, Baud Rate Setting
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Immobilizer Kontrol Modülü (J362)
technicalNotes:
Under certain circumstances this code may be stored after improperly operating the Vehicle/Ignition. For example after the Engine has stopped the Ignition is switched on again immediately (Engine Kontrol Modülü is still in the Start-Up Phase).
In such a case switch off the Ignition and wait at least 10 seconds before switching it back on. Then Kontrol edin: and clear Fault Codes.
